title: Metacognitive Therapy Versus Cognitive Behavioral Therapy: A Network Approach
n_days: Not specified, but data collected weekly for duration of therapy
network_types: temporal network, contemporaneous network, between-person network
limitations: - Limited sample size; - No formal statistical tests for comparing network structures between treatments; - No validation dataset for replication; - Items used may not fully represent the constructs (e.g., metacognition); - Analysis used a t-1 lag, which may not capture all temporal relationships.
notes: The paper does not mention preregistration. Code and data are declared available, but supplementary materials link does not provide direct access to code or data. The analysis used a t-1 lag, which may not capture all temporal relationships.
